title: Tiny Ancient Fish Fossil with Preserved Brain Offers Clues to Early Fish Evolution
description: CT scans of a 300-million-year-old minnow reveal well-preserved neural tissues, suggesting that the interior of the skull can be used to study the size and structure of early fish brains.

title: Hazlett: What ancient secrets lurk under the sofa cushions?
description: Like gravity, there is an unseen universal force that makes the couch a magnet for loose stuff. Phones, remote controls, dog chews, you name it.

title: British Antarctic Survey confirms Antarctica's first dinosaur fossil, 40 years on
description: A bone collected in Antarctica four decades ago has been identified as the first dinosaur fossil found on the continent, according to a study published in the journal Acta Palaeontologica Polonica. It is a tail vertebra from a titanosaur, the group of long-necked sauropods that includes the largest land animals that ever lived.

title: Ancient DNA challenges family assumptions in medieval Scandinavian graves
description: When archaeologists find adults and children buried together in medieval graves, it is often assumed that they were members of the same family. A new study from Stockholm University in Science Advances suggests otherwise.
